title.zh: 交易者通过推高 Hyperliquid 的 ETH 价格，在新上线的 1000 倍杠杆交易所 Papertrade 上净赚 128 万美元
title.en: Trader nets $1.28 million on new 1,000x exchange Papertrade by moving Hyperliquid’s ETH prices

current_state.zh:
据报道，一名交易者通过新上线、提供最高 1000 倍杠杆的交易所 Papertrade 推高 Hyperliquid 的 ETH 价格，净赚 128 万美元。同一钱包随后在周六夜间损失 45 万美元，原因是 30 个空头头寸在被持有超过三小时后遭到清算。

该报道将此事描述为一条具体涉及 Hyperliquid 的跨平台价格操纵路径，而 Hyperliquid 是规模最大的永续合约 DEX 之一，因此并非一次普通的交易亏损。

这 30 个空头头寸在周六夜间被清算，当时距其开仓已超过三个小时。
current_state.en:
A trader netted $1.28 million by pushing Hyperliquid's ETH prices through Papertrade, a newly launched exchange offering up to 1,000x leverage, according to the report. The same wallet later lost $450,000 when 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night after having been held open for more than three hours.

The report frames the episode as a concrete cross-venue price-manipulation vector touching Hyperliquid, one of the largest perpetual futures DEXs, rather than a routine trading loss.

The 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night, more than three hours after they were opened.

updates.background_zh: Papertrade 是构建在 Hyperliquid 的 HyperEVM 之上的合成永续合约 DEX，宣称支持最高 1000 倍杠杆；据 2026 年 10 月 10 日的报道，其存款与总锁仓量约为 1.18 亿美元。Hyperliquid 是一条 Layer 1 区块链，其 HyperCore 组件负责订单簿式的永续合约交易，HyperEVM 则处理 EVM 兼容的智能合约。
updates.background_en: Papertrade is a synthetic perpetual futures DEX built on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM that advertises leverage of up to 1,000x and, according to reports dated Oct. 10, 2026, had attracted roughly $118 million in deposits and total value locked. Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain whose HyperCore component processes orderbook-based perpetual futures trading, while HyperEVM handles EVM-compatible smart contracts.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于 Hyperliquid 的 ETH 永续合约市场：若一个新上线的高杠杆平台能够推动 HyperCore 所使用的标记价格，则该平台的交易者与清算引擎会通过价格喂价渠道受到影响，而非直接产生协议层面的损失。该事件也关系到市场如何评估 HyperEVM 上合成永续平台的杠杆上限与预言机设计。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through Hyperliquid's ETH perpetual markets: if a newly launched high-leverage venue can move the mark price used by HyperCore, traders and the liquidation engine there are exposed through the price-feed channel rather than through direct protocol losses. The episode also bears on how leverage caps and oracle design are evaluated for synthetic perp venues built on HyperEVM.

references.title: Papertrade Perp DEX Pulls in $118M in 24 Hours With 1,000x Leverage
